falsifier: any archived draft carries a current (non-stale) substance vote under today's ledger
hypothesis: the critic yield's rejected-kill rate and kill precision read 0 on every archived sweep because no draft can carry a current down-vote, not because the critic kills no rejected draft
intervention: an offline census of the 113 readable archived artifacts with the vote ledger, scoring the merged drafts and the reported claims through scorer.score_case; then #2283 makes each critic-yield rate with an empty denominator read None
reconsider_when: a vote is cast on a draft's own content, or ADR 0029 changes what a vote's digest reads
scope: 113 artifacts, 4,379 STRIDE drafts in development cases. 864 drafts carry a vote and each one reads stale: a vote judges a reported claim with its verdict (ADR 0029) and a draft has none. On the reported claims the same ledger gives 140 pooled, 43 rejected and 92 open. So rejected_before is 0 by construction, and the old 0.0 rates were a gap. Fixed in #2283 for the STRIDE and the ASVS yield. Behaviour on archived inputs measured; live downstream gain unmeasured.
signature: a critic-yield rate over an empty population reads 0.0, so a gap in the labels reads as a measured zero

falsifier: the not-real population (drafts with a current down-vote) is non-empty on a tracked Baseline
hypothesis: on the tracked Baselines, the critic's input populations can measure how often it rejects a reference-matched draft, and cannot measure how often it keeps an unsupported one
intervention: run.py scorecard over Baseline 6bff717 after #2283, which adds the critic panel: drafts by scored outcome and by fate, with needs-info as its own fate
reconsider_when: the ledger holds votes on drafts, or a labelled set of unsupported drafts exists
scope: Baseline 6bff717, one run, scored on today's corpus. real_rejected 8/71 (11%), real_needs_info 54/71 (76%), real confirmed 9/71. not_real_confirmed and not_real_needs_info 0/0, unavailable: 116 drafts are stale. Gross 8 reference-matched drafts killed, net 8 references no reported claim took. Real means a matched reference or a live pooling vote: relative to the reference set and the ledger, not semantic truth. Behaviour on archived inputs measured; live downstream gain unmeasured.
signature: the critic audit has no labelled population of unsupported drafts, and it merges needs-info into kept

falsifier: repair_prepared on a quote that differs from its source span by one negation token returns no span
hypothesis: the fan-in's quote repair can turn a quote into the source's opposite fact, because it keeps a span that moves a negation or a number and only marks it
intervention: an offline reproduction at the grounding seam (source A 'does not encrypt', quote 'does encrypt' labelled A), then #2297: grounding.faithful_repair refuses such a span, and the fan-in and the extraction gate both call it
reconsider_when: the repair threshold or the window scan changes, or a changed principal or control term is shown to pass the guard in an archived repair
scope: The reproduction repaired the quote to A's opposite span at similarity 0.976. Of 30 archived repairs, none moved a negation or a number, so no archived disposition changes. The guard compares negation and number tokens only and reads the best window only (ADR 0130). Behaviour on archived inputs measured; live downstream gain unmeasured.
signature: the quote repair rewrites a refused quote to a span that flips a negation or changes a number

falsifier: re-scoring a tracked Baseline before and after #2288 moves a value other than a 0.0 to unavailable
hypothesis: on the tracked Baselines, the only figures that read 0.0 over an empty denominator are writing objection rates and the rejected rate of reviewed findings, and no other figure moves when every such share reads unavailable
intervention: run.py score and run.py scorecard over the four tracked Baselines before and after #2288 (rates.ratio returns None; one display word, unavailable), with a JSON diff of the outputs
reconsider_when: a new instrument divides by a count that can be empty, or the maintainer bumps ARTIFACT_VERSION
scope: 152 changed values, each 0.0 to None, 76 figures counted once per series: objection_rate 13 cases in each of 2198870, d3f1898 and d4edd64 plus their pooled aggregate, and case 02 in 6bff717; rejected_rate_of_reviewed 11, 12 and 10 cases. No scorecard figure moved. ARTIFACT_VERSION stays 7 by the maintainer's ruling: each comparing reader fails closed on an old 0.0 beside a new null. Behaviour on archived inputs measured; live downstream gain unmeasured.
signature: a share over an empty denominator reads 0.0 across the eval instruments

falsifier: an archived confirmed claim cites an open ground that the critic did not name immaterial, or a disputed row is offered as settled
hypothesis: the fan-in and assembly promote an unknown, a dispute or an unverified quote into a confirmed fact on the archived blocks
intervention: an offline census of confirmed claims citing an open ground over the 113 readable artifacts, and scripted fixtures (#2299) for a wrong-source quote, identical text in two sources, absence against silence, a conflict carried to the verdict and a confirmation on an open fact, each beside a valid neighbour
reconsider_when: the maintainer rules on R2 or on the replay count, or a new ground kind or verdict field is added
scope: 51 archived confirmed claims cite an open ground, and the critic dismissed every one as immaterial (0 silent). The fixtures hold each state through join and assembly. R1 (E3) was the one promotion found. Two behaviours are pinned and left open for the maintainer: R2, a settled row beside an opposite graph value stays citable while the report names the contradiction; and the critic replay counts a returned or omitted draft as a disagreement. Behaviour on archived inputs measured; live downstream gain unmeasured.
signature: deterministic processing promotes an unknown, absent, disputed or unverified fact into a stronger status
